candidates.name: Concat
candidates.tagline: CapCut lets you edit the whole video, then wants a subscription at the Export button. Concat exports for free and never learned the word watermark.

replaces.name: CapCut Pro
replaces.note: secondary (2026); CapCut's own help page gives no public price, varies by region; builder's README says $9.99 to $19.99 a month

grudge.quote: I was really excited to complete and upload my first video ever, and everything seemed perfect until I clicked Export and it showed a popup saying that I had to pay a monthly subscription fee to use the most trivial features like voice changers.

candidates.name: Scan & Track
candidates.tagline: Calorie apps charge a subscription to read a free food database back to you. Scan & Track reads it for free.

grudge.quote: Every calorie tracker worth using wants an account, a subscription, or both, and most of them are a wrapper around the same free food database this one reads.

candidates.why: 7/10: grudge quotable +3, open source +2, vibe coded +2, no victim 0, price unverified 0. Browser barcode scanner on Open Food Facts, MIT, no account. No paid app named. Vibe coded per Claude co-author commit trailers. Repo one day old, 0 stars.
